I am a farmer here in Dedza, and this small plot is where my family's food comes from. I managed to get a FISP coupon this season, so I will put some fertilizer on the maize — but I will stretch it across this plot and part of my other land, so the rate will not be as strong as the government says. I also put manure from my goats because the soil has been tired, and I planted beans between the maize rows as we always do. I will work the plot myself with my wife; money is tight so I cannot pay ganyu this year, and the rains usually come so I do not irrigate.
